name: Dr. Maan Albarry — anatomical atlas image library
medicalReview: NONE. No physician has reviewed these images. Every asset is reviewStatus "pending" and approval "not approved" until Dr. Maan Albarry reviews it.

levels.L1: Homepage / card preview, 4:5, 480/800/1200 px wide, ≤120 KB
levels.L2: Procedure-page hero, 16:9, 640/1024/1600/2400 px wide (1600 ≤250 KB), JPEG fallback 1024/1600
levels.L3: Close-up of the structures the procedure acts on, 4:3, 640/1024/1600 px wide, ≤150 KB
levels.L4: Interactive: only the existing cataract 3D simulator (no new simulators).

backgrounds.transparent: WebP with alpha; place on any surface
backgrounds.neutral: WebP/JPEG on the series warm off-white (#FBF8F3 → #F1EBE2)

labelAnchorCoordinates: x, y normalised to the image frame (0,0 = top-left), identical for every size and background; projected from 3D eye coordinates through the shot camera

sagittal.name: Sagittal cut-away
sagittal.rule: Camera square to a meridional cut face (at most 20 degrees off its normal), anterior to the LEFT, long lens (fov 12-14 degrees) so the painted section reads like a textbook cross-section while the 3D tissue behind it keeps depth.

frontal.name: Frontal
frontal.rule: Along the visual axis, at most 25 degrees off-axis, the pupil near the frame centre: the view a patient knows from a mirror.

oblique.name: 3/4 oblique
oblique.rule: 35-65 degrees off the visual axis, raised 15-35 degrees, fov 16-18 degrees; a quadrant or wedge cut-away faces the camera so the 3D anatomy and two cut faces read together.

macro.name: Macro
macro.rule: Long lens (fov 10-12 degrees), frame height 2-8 mm, on one structure; the painted section is re-rasterised at the macro scale (not an upscaled crop).

legacy: The 1600 × 1000 card files images/procedures/<slug>[-dark][-800].webp used by the current pages are kept and re-rendered by scripts/illustrations/render.mjs.
